title: Allah Loves Me and Sees Me
summary: Instill in your child that Allah loves them and always sees them. Connect this to a feeling of safety, not fear: «Allah loves you, sees you, and protects you while you sleep.» Teach them that Allah rejoices when they are a good child (sharing their toys, listening to their mother). At this age, love and security are the gateway; do not link «Allah sees you» with punishment, but rather with love and joy, so that a heart grows accustomed to its Lord.
try_this: This week: When your child does a small good deed, tell them, «Allah saw you, and He loves what you did.» Before bed, remind them, «Allah loves you and protects you.»
reflection_prompts: How can you make «Allah sees me» feel like a sense of safety rather than fear for your young child?
When was the last time you connected your child’s good behavior to Allah’s joy in them?
